I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.
They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”
Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.
Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees…
But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

translations.web: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
translations.bsb: So they tried to seize Him, but no one laid a hand on Him, because His hour had not yet come.
translations.kjv: Then they sought to take him: but no man laid hands on him, because his hour was not yet come.
translations.asv: They sought therefore to take him: and no man laid his hand on him, because his hour was not yet come.
